title: 3 & 4 Counts Beginner - 2 Weeks
description: Foundational combinations. Master the first 8 patterns of both 3 Counts and 4 Counts series.

days.notes: 3 COUNTS 1-4: Basic hand-hand-foot combinations. Focus on resetting quickly after the kick.
3 COUNTS 5-8: Lateral steps and knee strikes. Incorporate movement into your combos.
3 COUNTS 1-8: Integration. Maintain consistent power across all three counts.
Rest day. Review the coordination of 3-beat rhythms.
4 COUNTS 1-4: Extended combinations starting with kicks. Focus on balance during transitions.
4 COUNTS 5-8: Hand-hand-foot-foot sequences. Build rhythmic endurance.
4 COUNTS 1-8: Integration. Keep your hands up during the entire sequence.
Week 1 complete! Both foundational sets mastered.
Increased volume. Focus on precision and non-telegraphed movements.
Increased volume. Work on the flow between counts 2 and 3.
Combined series. Switch between 3 and 4 count rhythms.
Endurance day. Maintain technical form even when fatigued.
Speed training. Focus on the rapid transition from count 4 back to guard.
Graduation Day. You've mastered the foundational 3 and 4 count patterns!
